aliases: Darcy-Weisbach friction factor; pipe friction factor
defining_expression: f_D = 8 tau_w / (rho U^2) for fully developed circular-pipe flow using mean velocity U
physical_interpretation: Dimensionless wall-friction measure used in pipe flow.

defining_expression: relative_roughness = epsilon / D or r / D
physical_interpretation: Wall roughness height normalized by pipe diameter.

defining_expression: Re_tau = u_tau h / nu for channel half-height h; Re_tau = u_tau delta / nu for boundary-layer thickness delta
physical_interpretation: Compares an outer wall-normal length to the viscous length nu/u_tau.
source: Journal of Fluid Mechanics wall-turbulence reference

defining_expression: Re = rho U L / mu = U L / nu
physical_interpretation: Ratio of inertial to viscous effects based on a chosen velocity and length scale.
Inertia relative to gravity-wave or free-surface effects.
source: Wang, A Guide to Fluid Mechanics, Ch. 8 Similarity and Dimensional Analysis
